about.heading: About
paragraphs: I’m Brandon, born and raised in Monterey, CA. I enjoy taking complicated systems apart, understanding how they work, and finding ways to make them safer.

I started out building software, but cybersecurity became the part I cared about most: protecting the technology people rely on every day. These days, I build internal security tools at Disney and spend my free time experimenting with new ideas.
My aim is simple: make technology safer and more reliable, and raise digital literacy along the way.

contact.heading: Let's build something.
contact.blurb: I am always here to learn!

marquee.quote: Life's simple. You make choices and you don't look back.
I live my life a quarter mile at a time. For those ten seconds or less, I'm free.
What was the song of the sirens like?
Now I am become Death, the destroyer of worlds.
It's not who I am underneath, but what I do that defines me.
You either die a hero, or live long enough to become the villain.
Sometimes you gotta run before you can walk.
Part of the journey is the end.
Don't be what they made you.
John is a man of focus, commitment, sheer will.
What we do in life echoes in eternity.
Where we're going, we don't need roads.
